tracks.title: 一碗苦茶
tracks.genre: Cantonese opera-film song pop with small band (siu kuk tune, gaohu and yangqin)
tracks.subject: a young man who orders a bowl of the bitterest twenty-four-herb tea every day at a herbal tea shop just to keep talking to the girl at the counter, until she tells him to stop drinking and shares a honey tea instead
